ranked.title: ACM, the only INVESTABLE call, sits 3% under its entry floor at a price now refreshed, five days old
ranked.case: ACM's dive (data/stocks/ACM__data-center-moratoria.json) sets the entry zone at $61.00 to $71.00, no_entry_above $75.00, review_by 2026-12-04; the floor is the price where the dive's own reverse-DCF bisection (base FCF $684.9M, 9% discount, 2.5% terminal growth) asks for zero real FCF growth, $61.05, and it coincides with the 2026-08-12 low print of $61.04. data/market/ACM.json was refreshed 2026-10-13: last print $59.01 on 2026-10-12 (yfinance and stockanalysis agree), 52-week low now $58.28, so the stock has printed a new low since the dive was written and sits $1.99 under the floor. Two S5 trips stand on the 2026-09-24 close of $58.52 (data-center-moratoria S5 and minor-nsr-permits S5). The question that was open last week is now sharper: the dive says a skeptical rebuild still defends $71.28, and the market is paying less than the zero-growth price. Either the zone is cheaper than the dive priced, or the consultancy de-rating is the first evidence the thesis is wrong. A break of $58.28 would be the first print below both trip levels. The price is five days old; a fresh price request plus `refresh data/stocks/ACM__data-center-moratoria.json` is the only thing that settles it before 2026-12-04.

ranked.title: Three methanol-chain indicators have now tripped, and the IMO vote that decides which one matters is still unknown to the machine
ranked.case: SIG-20260901-04 rests on the divergence between the IMO Net-Zero Framework postponement (the card cites the 57 to 49 to 21 vote of October 2025) and Singapore's methanol-bunkering licences, valid five years from 2026-01-01, running regardless. The reconvened MEPC session, EVT-20260901-01 dated 2026-10-01, is still WATCHING in data/calendar/events.json because radar, the stage that sweeps the calendar, is paused. The chain's indicators now say two things: shipyards are weakening and terminals are strengthening. New this week, S2 (Hanwha Ocean 042660.KS closes at or below 70,000 KRW, the record-order narrative losing its catalyst) tripped on 2026-10-14 at 67,000 KRW, a new 52-week low. S5 (HD Korea Shipbuilding 009540.KS at or below 330,000) tripped 2026-10-02 at 323,500 and the stock has since fallen to 280,500 on 2026-10-14, with the 52-week low reset to 278,000. S3 (Royal Vopak at or above 49.00 EUR, regional clocks compounding without a global catalyst) tripped 2026-10-09 on a 51.05 print dated 2026-10-07; that file was last fetched 2026-10-09 so the terminal read is the stalest of the three. Note that S2's text is about an adjourned or rejected vote while its indicator is a price, so the trip is circumstantial for the vote, not proof of it. A single lookup of the MEPC result would tell you which scenario to weight. No dive exists on this chain, so no verdict moves; its one instrument (KRBN) is still unrated.

ranked.title: The page's two biggest opportunities are both on the H5N1 chain, both stuck behind the pause, while CALM keeps making lows
ranked.case: tools/opportunities.py ranks poultry primary genetics first (size 78.7: moves a lot 90, keeps the profit 95, few have noticed 8; screened, best name TSN, next step `run selection CAMP-20260901-01`) and specific-pathogen-free eggs and pandemic countermeasures second (size 59.8; no census yet, example CRL, next step `run universe h5n1-panzootic`). SIG-20260910-01 scored unmappedness 82 on a measurable gap: the card counted 800 feed items across 19 sources with exactly one incidental mention of avian influenza, against evidence of 50,000-plus common-crane carcasses on the western European flyway at the end of 2025 and 76 per cent southern-elephant-seal pup mortality at Heard Island (Australian Antarctic Division surveys, October 2025 and January 2026). The chain's S3 indicator has tripped: Cal-Maine printed 62.71 on 2026-10-13, below the 72.44 trip level, the 68.48 recorded at trip, and its own 62.70 52-week low, so the de-rating the scenario calls a quiet season letting the already-de-rated complex fall further is continuing (latest print 63.16 on 2026-10-14). The Board's own first and second ranked links cannot advance until the campaign pause lifts; this is the largest cost of the pause the page shows. The card's review_by is 2026-12-09.

ranked.title: The rare-earth suspension expires in 24 days and the card's own review date is 26 days overdue
ranked.case: SIG-20260901-02 (EVENT clock, review_by 2026-09-21, unmappedness 58) rests on MOFCOM's suspension of the rare-earth export-control announcements expiring 2026-11-10, a date fixed by the announcement itself, not an estimate (EVT-20260831-02, status PROMOTED). The card cites the IEA's figure of USD 6.5 trillion a year of downstream production outside China at risk, and its own retail_gap says the rare-earth miner rally (MP Materials +165%, Lynas +159%) is the crowded trade TASTE-001 already refuses, so the open question is which listed names hold separation or magnet-grade capacity. Tally's appraisal IMP-20260830-16 put it in the LEAKY band with public_reach 40. The chain's S1 indicator (300748.SZ staying under 32.0) tripped at 24.78 and the stock printed 24.05 on 2026-10-09 against a 52-week low of 23.80, a file fetched 2026-10-10 and not since refreshed. Nothing has re-examined the card since the date was set. The decision date is the one forcing event on this list with a hard calendar edge, and 24 days is still enough time to decide before it.

ranked.title: DKNG is hugging its 52-week low and the chain's third-ranked link has no listed issuer to buy

The chain's S5 scenario ("The pool disappoints") has tripped twice: VIRT at 60.86 on 2026-09-11 and DKNG at 19.60 on 2026-10-05 against the 20.72 level. DKNG closed at 19.72 on 2026-10-13 and 18.90 on 2026-10-14, against a 52-week low of 18.59 that has not been broken, so S5's own wording ("breaks its 52-week low") has not literally happened yet. VIRT's file was last fetched 2026-10-09 (last print 57.81 on 2026-10-08), so that name is a week blind. The page ranks the player-eligibility-gate link (identity verification, KYC/AML and geolocation gating; size 46.7) third overall, with no listed issuer on it yet, so there is nothing to act on, only a scenario to re-weight. Watch 18.59.
